title: Plasmon poles for the linearized Coulomb--Hartree--Fock equation
summary: We study the time-dependent Hartree--Fock equation in $\R^3$ with physical Coulomb interactions in both direct and exchange channels, with exchange coupling $η$, linearized about homogeneous equilibria $γ_f=g(-i\nabla)$ having compact momentum support. Nguyen and You showed that, without exchange, two purely imaginary plasmon poles $\pm iτ_0(|k|)$ exist below a survival threshold $κ_0>0$. Existing nonlinear Hartree--Fock theory requires a short-range direct interaction and a smooth small exchange kernel, excluding the present Coulomb setting.
